why_head_accent: You want the dice rolled for you.
why_lead: There's a reason the original sold over a billion units. The Magic 8 Ball isn't fortune-telling; it's a tiny ritual that lets you off the hook of having to choose.
why_body: Should you text first? Pizza or curry? Take the job or wait? Sometimes the answer doesn't matter half as much as just deciding. The ball decides for you. Then you find out how you feel about it.
stats: Classic answers, all hand-balanced. 10 yes, 5 no, 5 'ask again later' — like the original.
Hand-crafted ball themes in Plus. From Crystal to Inferno to Bloom.

faq: Is this just the Magic 8 Ball app?
It's the Magic 8 Ball app done properly. Real physics, beautiful art, no ad-stuffing. The version we wanted to exist.
Why pay for a Magic 8 Ball?
You don't have to — the free version is genuinely complete. Plus exists if you want all the themes and you'd rather pay once than see ads.
Does it actually predict the future?
It actually does not. Probability says it'll be right slightly under 50% of the time. The fun is in the ritual, not the result.
Yes — no inappropriate answers, no scary themes, rated 4+/Everyone. Bedtime questions encouraged.
Always. Shake works on a plane, in a tent, on the moon.
Will I get pestered with notifications?
Never. Eight Ball Wisdom doesn't push notifications. The ball waits for you.
Refund if I don't like it?
Plus is one cheap one-off. If you want a refund within 14 days, message us — done, no fuss.
